scope: Read-only design for preserving a failed stock inventory call; no root-cause or real inventory qualification is established by this note.

evidencePrecision.rootReportedOwnedOutcome: exit1, exact reaped, group gone, fatal monitor null

minimumJournalContract.parentPreallocation: Attach an inventoryDiagnostic object before launching the inventory stage, with unknown fields and an explicit collecting status.
minimumJournalContract.parentFinally: Read, validate and safely project the journal after Runner cleanup on success and failure. Ordinary diagnostic read/parse/projection failures cannot replace existing Runner firstFailure.
minimumJournalContract.phaseMeaning: Last reached instrumentation boundary, not proof of the failing statement, stuck API or root cause. Missing entry/journal means unavailable, not an inferred startup failure.
minimumJournalContract.earlyBoundaryLimit: If imports happen before the instrumented function, their failure cannot be localized by an entry inside that function. Either include those imports in the protected boundary or preserve explicit pre-entry unknown state.
minimumJournalContract.typedFailure: Fixed exception class enum, fixed literal Failure code allowlist or unknown; optional bounded integer errno and explicitly typed SystemExit None/int value. No exception string, traceback text, arbitrary class/module name or path.
minimumJournalContract.moduleBindings: Use a fixed small role allowlist for stock xpcshell/parser/mach/build/logging imports. Project expected source-relative identity and verified hash booleans or the matching known pin; keep actual __file__, module search paths and unknown values private.
minimumJournalContract.caps: Fixed schema, strict key/type/enumeration validation, monotonically numbered bounded events, nondecreasing elapsed values, at most a few dozen events and a small fixed byte cap.
minimumJournalContract.unknowns: Missing, truncated, duplicate, foreign, stale or unreadable journal becomes unavailable with unknown phase/error/counts, never a zero measurement.
minimumJournalContract.writeFailure: Record evidenceWriteFailure separately. Preserve original exception and nonzero status. A fixed bounded stdout fallback is optional only if the parent actually consumes it into the final public receipt; unittest/private-log print alone repeats the evidence gap.
minimumJournalContract.firstAndCleanupCause: Capture the original primary before logger/class restoration. A restoration or diagnostic-write failure remains separate and cannot overwrite it. A cleanup-only failure must still reject success.

mustRemainUnchanged: Original stock tests, assertions, manifests and expected statuses.
Original stock prefs/updateMozinfo/default selection and exact 45-ID binding.
Inventory no-test/no-server guards, permitted dump SystemExit values and class/logger restoration.
Original job monotonic clock, shared345/platform360, resource/unknown stops and exact owned cleanup.
No journal status or successful partial global dump may qualify a failed scope or make an unavailable count PASS.
minimumMeaningfulControls: Injected import/module-exec failure retains fixed phase and typed class without arbitrary message/path.
Build binding, install-tests, global stock call and scope stock call failures are separately locatable.
Original primary plus logger restoration failure plus write/read failure preserves primary and rejects success.
Success path keeps the same dump output, IDs/statuses/default options and zero test/server instantiation.
Missing/partial/duplicate/stale/foreign journal yields unknown and cannot make proof_complete true.
Parent actual Runner failure path still publishes the safe journal; normal post-run success-only reads are insufficient.
Public projection drops machine paths, PIDs, argv, environment, free text, private module aliases and injected sentinels.

minimalNextExecution.usefulDiscriminatingHypothesis: The original stage failed before inventory qualification. The next correctly bound real invocation should distinguish stock imports/module loading, configured build/install setup and each stock dump/validation boundary.
minimalNextExecution.preferredBoundedRoute: If a short diagnostic is needed, reuse the guarded actual restored/configured Mac object environment and helper preparation, stop after inventory proof and safe evidence publication; omit XUL targets and scope execution until inventory passes.
minimalNextExecution.SDKlessImportControlLimit: An import-only Mac check can validate module/site bindings but does not prove installed global population, mozinfo/prefs filtering or configured inventory.
minimalNextExecution.checkpointExpiry: Acquisition must remain through a genuinely unexpired ordinary origin with unchanged guards. Time pressure does not justify bypassing expiry or substituting a local retained download.
